summary: No installer-harming behavior observed in merchantprefsservice-paypal@24.0.0
details: The package contents produced no matches against supply-chain attack rules and no traced behaviors indicating credential access, network exfiltration, install-time remote code execution, silent relay, backdoor, or self-propagation. The name resembles an internal PayPal service identifier, but name resemblance alone is not a threat and the shipped code shows no installer-facing harmful mechanism.
